evidence_coverage.message: PARTIAL EVIDENCE: 3/4 paths reached target; 3/4 audits pass

force_definition: bottom-platen constraint force on model; positive upward compression; no multiplier
gap_definition: reference arclength mean of upper minus lower material interface height
sample_policy: all accepted FE states; references only at committed audit rows; lines connect samples, with no new samples or mechanical interpolation
error_policy: signed FE minus reference from archived Decimal strings before binary64 plotting conversion
interpretation: finite-medium leakage is not a measured contact-onset event; colors identify material regions only

spec.scope: HF4-A and HF4-B uniform normal contact; no cylinder or candidate qualification

model_criteria.scope: prospective diagnostic allowance for this synthetic task only

spec.hp_states: all accepted states including bisections and zero
spec.hp_crosscheck_states: last original target of each of the four paths
spec.force_convention: bottom constraint-on-model +y positive; top constraint-on-model +y negative; model-on-platen is the opposite; no factor two
spec.stop_policy: Failure of reference, implementation, HP, positive J or resources stops dependent work. Model mismatch is reported separately. No threshold or parameter change to obtain PASS. Preserve failures and record any subsequent correction before retry.
